title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH SHOWCASE
description: The feature asks players to perform progress for each other before asking whether the progress is good. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Boss intros and failure states now create cleaner moments for streams, trailers, and context-free yelling.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. Marketing finally found footage that did not require a glossary.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH FOUNDATION
description: The update spends credibility in one place and tries to earn it back somewhere else. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Several improvements focus on crash fixes, save safety, and boring reliability instead of visible beats.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. The game improved in ways that make terrible thumbnails.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH CHECK-IN
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.

title: ASPIRATIONAL ROADMAP REFRESH BREATHER
description: The change is pitched as onboarding, but it quietly rewires what the team thinks a beginner is worth. Previously announced features have been reframed as directional pillars while the team evaluates delivery confidence. Daily chores have been shortened so players can leave before the evening becomes a second job.
consequence: The roadmap survived by becoming less related to roads. Engagement dipped, but so did the farewell essays.
